_provenance: NSE's live "latest announcements" feed (nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/RSS/Online_announcements.xml), captured to a committed snapshot. Company names, subjects and the filing PDF are NSE's own, reproduced unchanged; the document stays on their server and every row links to it where NSE gave a link. The ticker on each row is this dashboard's resolution of the filing company's name to an NSE symbol, so the feed can be narrowed to a reader's holdings; a name we cannot place keeps ticker null and shows only in Universe. Nothing here is scored, ranked or judged.

rows.subject: General Updates
rows.description: We write further to our previous intimation(s) regarding the approval of the Board of Directors and the Members of the Company for the issue of Equity Share Warrants on a preferential basis.In this regard, we wish to inform you that the Members of the Company accorded their approval by way of a Special Resolution on 22 September 2026, and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited granted its in-principle approval on 14 October 2026. The Board of Directors of the Company, by way of a resolution passed through circulation, has approved the allotment of 11,92,200 (Eleven Lakh Ninety-Two Thousand Two Hundred) Equity Share Warrants to Mr. Mukul Mahavir Agrawal, belonging to the Non-Promoter Category, at an issue price of ₹210/- (Rupees Two Hundred Ten only) per Warrant on October 23, 2026.The aggregate issue price of the Warrants is ₹25,03,62,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Crore Three Lakh Sixty-Two Thousand Only). The Company has received ₹6,25,90,500/- (Rupees Six Crore Twenty-Five Lakh Ninety Thousand Five Hundred Only), being 25% of the aggregate issue price, in accordance with Regulation 162 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. The balance 75% amounting to ₹18,77,71,500/- (Rupees Eighteen Crore Seventy-Seven Lakh Seventy-One Thousand Five Hundred Only) shall be payable upon exercise of the Warrants in accordance with the terms of issue. |SUBJECT: General Updates
